Tap and keyboard keep existing semantics; content scroll stays separate; cancellation removes capture, listeners and preview on viewport/native activity/country changes.
Reduced motion, interrupted transitions and live PWA notice room are respected without adding a globe, Canvas, renderer, camera or data store.
